Attribute VB_Name = "mod_CreateFB"
Option Explicit


Sub GrabOutlets(Optional bTest As Boolean)

'Replaces old F&B sheet to save nearly a meg of space per iteration.
'Also runs at user startup to speed up GRR batch
'J Phillips - March 2013


Dim shtData As Excel.Worksheet
Dim shtTarget As Excel.Worksheet
Dim shtTemplate As Excel.Worksheet
Dim rngDataFB As Excel.Range
Dim rngOutletTemplate As Excel.Range
Dim rngBanqTemplate As Excel.Range
Dim rngTemplate As Excel.Range


Dim rowDataRevStart As Integer
Dim rowDataRevEnd As Integer
Dim rowDataCovStart As Integer
Dim rowDataCovEnd As Integer
Dim rowData As Integer
Dim rowDataCov As Integer
Dim rowTarget As Integer
Dim coltest As Integer
Dim colPTDAct As Integer
Dim colFPFcst As Integer
Dim strTemplate As String
Dim strInsertRange As String
Dim strReplace1 As String
Dim strReplace2 As String

Dim rowDept As Integer
Dim rowDeptCov As Integer
Dim DeptID As String
Dim intTempRows As Integer


'set variables
Set shtData = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
Set shtTarget = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B")
Set shtTemplate = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B template")
shtTemplate.Visible = xlSheetVisible


Set rngOutletTemplate = shtTemplate.Range("Template_Outlet")
Set rngBanqTemplate = shtTemplate.Range("Template_Banquet")

rowDataRevStart = shtData.Range("F_B").Row
rowDataRevEnd = shtData.Range("F_BCov").Row - 1
rowDataCovStart = shtData.Range("F_BCov").Row
rowDataCovEnd = shtData.Range("F_BSum").Row - 1
rowTarget = 12
strReplace1 = "$" & shtTemplate.Range("replaceRow").Value
strReplace2 = "$" & (shtTemplate.Range("replaceRow").Value - 1)
rowDept = 0

'get rid of any old data
Call ClearOutlets


'Find a F&B Dept Revenue
For rowData = rowDataRevStart To rowDataRevEnd

    'Find the Dept
    If Len(shtData.Range("A" & rowData).Value) = 4 Then 'found the dept line
        rowDept = rowData
        DeptID = shtData.Range("A" & rowData).Value
        
        'What Template?
        Select Case Left(DeptID, 3)
        Case "023"
            strTemplate = "Banq"
            Set rngTemplate = rngBanqTemplate
            'intTempRows = 15
            intTempRows = 16
            strInsertRange = "BANQ_TOTALS"
        Case Else
            strTemplate = "Outlet"
            Set rngTemplate = rngOutletTemplate
            'intTempRows = 11
            intTempRows = 12
            strInsertRange = "OUTLET_TOTALS"
        End Select
        
    End If
    
    If rowDept = 0 Then GoTo SkipDept
    
    'Find the Dept Total and test for values
    If Right(shtData.Range("A" & rowData).Value, 8) <> "NREVENUE" Then GoTo SkipDept
    
    'found the total line, Find out if there is any revenue at all
    For coltest = 4 To 60   'arbitrary number of columns to look for used numbers
        If Abs(shtData.Cells(rowData, coltest).Value) > 1 Then
            'there is a value here - we need the dept
            GoTo UseDept
        End If
    Next coltest
    
    'No value in this dept - start with a new dept
    rowDept = 0
        
    GoTo SkipDept

UseDept:
    
    If rowDept = 0 Then GoTo SkipDept
    
    
    'This is a valid Dept to add - go ahead and create the block
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    rowTarget = shtTarget.Range(strInsertRange).Row
    shtTarget.Rows(rowTarget & ":" & (rowTarget + intTempRows)).Insert Shift:=xlDown, CopyOrigin:=xlFormatFromLeftOrAbove
    
    rngTemplate.Copy shtTarget.Range("A" & rowTarget)
    
    shtTarget.Range("A" & rowTarget).Formula = "=Data!B" & rowDept
    
    'Time to find the covers
    For rowDataCov = rowDataCovStart To rowDataCovEnd

        'Find the Dept
        If shtData.Range("A" & rowDataCov).Value = DeptID Then 'found the dept line
            Exit For
        End If
    Next rowDataCov
    
    If rowDataCov = rowDataCovEnd Then
    'never found the covers, put in a row that will return zero
        rowDataCov = 9998
    End If
    
    'replace the fake formula with the right rows
    shtTarget.Rows(rowTarget & ":" & (rowTarget + intTempRows)).Replace What:=strReplace1, Replacement:="$" & (rowDept + 1), LookAt:=xlPart, _
        SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
    
    shtTarget.Rows(rowTarget & ":" & (rowTarget + intTempRows)).Replace What:=strReplace2, Replacement:="$" & (rowDataCov + 1), LookAt:=xlPart, _
        SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
    
    
    Debug.Print "Created a section referencing " & DeptID & "(" & rowDept & ") on row " & rowTarget & " from Data row " & rowData & " " & strTemplate
    
    rowDept = 0
    
    





SkipDept:
Next rowData


DeptsCreated:

Call HideUnusedFB

shtTemplate.Visible = False



Set shtData = Nothing
Set shtTarget = Nothing
Set shtTemplate = Nothing

Set rngDataFB = Nothing
Set rngBanqTemplate = Nothing
Set rngOutletTemplate = Nothing
Set rngTemplate = Nothing




End Sub

Sub ClearOutlets(Optional bTest As Boolean)

Dim shtTarget1 As Excel.Worksheet

Dim intClearRow As Integer
Dim intBotRow As Integer

Set shtTarget1 = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B")

shtTarget1.Cells.EntireRow.Hidden = False


'Kill Bqt data
intClearRow = shtTarget1.Range("OUTLET_TOTALS")(shtTarget1.Range("OUTLET_TOTALS").Count).Row + 1
intBotRow = shtTarget1.Range("BANQ_TOTALS").Row - 1

If intBotRow >= intClearRow Then
    shtTarget1.Range("A" & intClearRow & ":A" & intBotRow).EntireRow.Delete
End If

'Kill Outlet data
intClearRow = 12
intBotRow = shtTarget1.Range("OUTLET_TOTALS").Row - 1

If intBotRow >= intClearRow Then
    shtTarget1.Range("A" & intClearRow & ":A" & intBotRow).EntireRow.Delete
End If

Set shtTarget1 = Nothing



End Sub


Sub HideUnusedFB(Optional bTest As Boolean)
Dim shtTarget2 As Excel.Worksheet

Dim intCurrRow As Integer
Dim intBotRow As Integer
Dim strTestColumn As String

Application.Calculate

Set shtTarget2 = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B")
strTestColumn = "CJ"

intBotRow = shtTarget2.Range("BANQ_TOTALS").Row

For intCurrRow = 12 To intBotRow

    If shtTarget2.Range(strTestColumn & intCurrRow).Value = 1 Then
        shtTarget2.Rows(intCurrRow).Hidden = True
    End If
Next intCurrRow


    shtTarget2.Columns("CI:CO").EntireColumn.Hidden = True


Set shtTarget2 = Nothing




End Sub

'J Phillips - March 2013


Dim shtData As Excel.Worksheet
Dim shtTarget As Excel.Worksheet
Dim shtTemplate As Excel.Worksheet
Dim rngDataFB As Excel.Range
Dim rngOutletTemplate As Excel.Range
Dim rngBanqTemplate As Excel.Range
Dim rngTemplate As Excel.Range


Dim rowDataRevStart As Integer
Dim rowDataRevEnd As Integer
Dim rowDataCovStart As Integer
Dim rowDataCovEnd As Integer
Dim rowData As Integer
Dim rowDataCov As Integer
Dim rowTarget As Integer
Dim coltest As Integer
Dim colPTDAct As Integer
Dim colFPFcst As Integer
Dim strTemplate As String
Dim strInsertRange As String
Dim strReplace1 As String
Dim strReplace2 As String

Dim rowDept As Integer
Dim rowDeptCov As Integer
Dim DeptID As String
Dim intTempRows As Integer


'set variables
Set shtData = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
Set shtTarget = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B")
Set shtTemplate = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B template")
shtTemplate.Visible = xlSheetVisible


Set rngOutletTemplate = shtTemplate.Range("Template_Outlet")
Set rngBanqTemplate = shtTemplate.Range("Template_Banquet")

rowDataRevStart = shtData.Range("F_B").Row
rowDataRevEnd = shtData.Range("F_BCov").Row - 1
rowDataCovStart = shtData.Range("F_BCov").Row
rowDataCovEnd = shtData.Range("F_BSum").Row - 1
rowTarget = 12
strReplace1 = "$" & shtTemplate.Range("replaceRow").Value
strReplace2 = "$" & (shtTemplate.Range("replaceRow").Value - 1)
rowDept = 0

'get rid of any old data
Call ClearOutlets


'Find a F&B Dept Revenue
For rowData = rowDataRevStart To rowDataRevEnd

    'Find the Dept
    If Len(shtData.Range("A" & rowData).Value) = 4 Then 'found the dept line
        rowDept = rowData
        DeptID = shtData.Range("A" & rowData).Value
        
        'What Template?
        Select Case Left(DeptID, 3)
        Case "023"
            strTemplate = "Banq"
            Set rngTemplate = rngBanqTemplate
            'intTempRows = 15
            intTempRows = 16
            strInsertRange = "BANQ_TOTALS"
        Case Else
            strTemplate = "Outlet"
            Set rngTemplate = rngOutletTemplate
            'intTempRows = 11
            intTempRows = 12
            strInsertRange = "OUTLET_TOTALS"
        End Select
        
    End If
    
    If rowDept = 0 Then GoTo SkipDept
    
    'Find the Dept Total and test for values
    If Right(shtData.Range("A" & rowData).Value, 8) <> "NREVENUE" Then GoTo SkipDept
    
    'found the total line, Find out if there is any revenue at all
    For coltest = 4 To 60   'arbitrary number of columns to look for used numbers
        If Abs(shtData.Cells(rowData, coltest).Value) > 1 Then
            'there is a value here - we need the dept
            GoTo UseDept
        End If
    Next coltest
    
    'No value in this dept - start with a new dept
    rowDept = 0
        
    GoTo SkipDept

UseDept:
    
    If rowDept = 0 Then GoTo SkipDept
    
    
    'This is a valid Dept to add - go ahead and create the block
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    rowTarget = shtTarget.Range(strInsertRange).Row
    shtTarget.Rows(rowTarget & ":" & (rowTarget + intTempRows)).Insert Shift:=xlDown, CopyOrigin:=xlFormatFromLeftOrAbove
    
    rngTemplate.Copy shtTarget.Range("A" & rowTarget)
    
    shtTarget.Range("A" & rowTarget).Formula = "=Data!B" & rowDept
    
    'Time to find the covers
    For rowDataCov = rowDataCovStart To rowDataCovEnd

        'Find the Dept
        If shtData.Range("A" & rowDataCov).Value = DeptID Then 'found the dept line
            Exit For
        End If
    Next rowDataCov
    
    If rowDataCov = rowDataCovEnd Then
    'never found the covers, put in a row that will return zero
        rowDataCov = 9998
    End If
    
    'replace the fake formula with the right rows
    shtTarget.Rows(rowTarget & ":" & (rowTarget + intTempRows)).Replace What:=strReplace1, Replacement:="$" & (rowDept + 1), LookAt:=xlPart, _
        SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
    
    shtTarget.Rows(rowTarget & ":" & (rowTarget + intTempRows)).Replace What:=strReplace2, Replacement:="$" & (rowDataCov + 1), LookAt:=xlPart, _
        SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=False, ReplaceFormat:=False
    
    
    Debug.Print "Created a section referencing " & DeptID & "(" & rowDept & ") on row " & rowTarget & " from Data row " & rowData & " " & strTemplate
    
    rowDept = 0
    
    





SkipDept:
Next rowData


DeptsCreated:

Call HideUnusedFB

shtTemplate.Visible = False



Set shtData = Nothing
Set shtTarget = Nothing
Set shtTemplate = Nothing

Set rngDataFB = Nothing
Set rngBanqTemplate = Nothing
Set rngOutletTemplate = Nothing
Set rngTemplate = Nothing




End Sub

Sub ClearOutlets(Optional bTest As Boolean)

Dim intClearRow As Integer
Dim intBotRow As Integer

Set shtTarget1 = ActiveWorkbook.Sheets("F&B")

shtTarget1.Cells.EntireRow.Hidden = False


'Kill Bqt data
intClearRow = shtTarget1.Range("OUTLET_TOTALS")(shtTarget1.Range("OUTLET_TOTALS").Count).Row + 1
intBotRow = shtTarget1.Range("BANQ_TOTALS").Row - 1

If intBotRow >= intClearRow Then
    shtTarget1.Range("A" & intClearRow & ":A" & intBotRow).EntireRow.Delete

'Kill Outlet data

intBotRow = shtTarget1.Range("OUTLET_TOTALS").Row - 1

If intBotRow >= intClearRow Then
    shtTarget1.Range("A" & intClearRow & ":A" & intBotRow).EntireRow.Delete
End If

Set shtTarget1 = Nothing



End Sub
